name: Snow White
source:
In the lagoon city of Neo Venice, you spend a peaceful everyday life with Alicia, Akari and others. 
Welcome to the beautiful planet of water. You can heal yourself with a sweet love story here. 

[from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE065592.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
在瀉湖城市新威尼斯，你與艾莉西亞、燈里等人度過著平靜的日常生活。歡迎來到這顆美麗的水之星球。你可以在這裡讓甜蜜的戀愛故事療癒身心。

［來自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE065592.html]DLsite英文版[/url]］
